# Notebook 10 -- Low-flow-aware model ranking & the H1 verdict

**What this notebook does.** Consumes `data_processed/lowflow/`
(`lowflow_metrics_wide.csv`, `metric_pairwise_rho.csv`) and:

1. **De-duplicates metrics** before any averaging (AGENTS.md guardrail 5):
   walks metric pairs in descending |rho|; for every pair with
   |rho| > 0.9 drops the member that is more correlated with the *rest*
   of the suite. Every drop decision + reason is written to
   `metric_dedup_decision.csv`. Nothing is averaged before this step.
2. **Builds the low-flow-aware ranking**: per catchment, models are ranked on
   each kept metric (lower = better; logNSE reversed), ranks averaged within
   catchment, then rank sums aggregated across catchments into the composite
   low-flow ranking (same construction as the HYD_30 discharge ranking, so
   the two are directly comparable).
3. **Tests H1** (decision rule, pre-registered in AGENTS.md 18 Nov 2026):
   *forcing-skill rank and low-flow-skill rank diverge; the framework fails
   if the pooled rank correlation rho > 0.6, in which case it collapses to
   one stage and the paper must say so.*
   Pooled rho = Spearman between the QED_30 forcing composite rank and the
   low-flow composite rank over the 22 models, with a catchment-bootstrap
   CI (1,000 resamples, fixed seed) so the verdict carries uncertainty.
4. Writes `h1_verdict.md` -- the contract between analysis and paper: no
   results section without it.

**Requires:** `LOWFLOW_00_metrics.Rmd` has completed (its wide metrics table
exists and the pairwise-rho table exists).

```{r log-file}
low_output_dir <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "lowflow")
low_log_file   <- file.path(low_output_dir, "lowflow_10_log.txt")
wide_fp <- file.path(low_output_dir, "lowflow_metrics_wide.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(wide_fp))   # LOWFLOW_00 must have run
```

## 1. Configuration

```{r config}
# direction of each metric: TRUE = higher value is better
low_metric_better_high <- c(logNSE = TRUE, q95_bias = FALSE,
                            lf_volume_bias = FALSE, dry_spell_bias = FALSE,
                            mam7_bias = FALSE)
low_dedup_rho_max <- 0.9      # guardrail 5 threshold
low_h1_rho_fail   <- 0.6      # H1 decision rule threshold (pre-registered)
low_min_catchments_share <- 0.8   # model must have metrics for >= 80% of the
                                  # catchment roster to be ranked
low_n_boot   <- 1000L
low_boot_seed <- 20261118L
```

## 2. Load metrics + roster

```{r load}
wide <- data.table::fread(wide_fp, colClasses = list(character = "catchment"))
low_metrics_vec <- names(low_metric_better_high)
cat("metric rows:", nrow(wide), "| models:",
    data.table::uniqueN(wide$model), "| catchments:",
    data.table::uniqueN(wide$catchment), "\n")

# catchment roster: catchments with at least one valid metric row
roster <- unique(wide[!is.na(logNSE), .(catchment)])
cat("roster (catchments with computable metrics):", nrow(roster), "\n")

# model coverage check (no silent shrinkage of the model set)
cov <- wide[!is.na(logNSE), .(n_catch = data.table::uniqueN(catchment)), by = model]
cov[, share := n_catch / nrow(roster)]
models_keep <- cov[share >= low_min_catchments_share, model]
models_drop <- cov[share <  low_min_catchments_share, model]
if (length(models_drop)) {
   cat("DROPPED from ranking (coverage < ", low_min_catchments_share, "):",
       paste(models_drop, collapse = ", "), "\n")
   writeLines(
      paste0(format(Sys.time()),
             " | LOWFLOW_10 dropped models for low coverage: ",
             paste(models_drop, collapse = ", ")),
      low_log_file, append = TRUE)
}
wide <- wide[model %in% models_keep]
```

## 3. Metric de-duplication (guardrail 5 -- inspect before compositing)

```{r dedup, eval=TRUE}
# authoritative pairwise rho: recomputed here from the wide metrics so the
# decision is self-contained (metric_pairwise_rho.csv from LOWFLOW_00 is the
# cross-check)
avail <- intersect(names(low_metric_better_high), names(wide))
vals <- wide[, .SD, .SDcols = avail]
rho_emp <- stats::cor(vals, method = "spearman",
                      use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(round(rho_emp, 3))

# walk pairs in descending |rho|; drop the member more correlated with the rest
kept <- avail; drop_log <- list()
repeat {
   if (length(kept) < 3) break
   r <- abs(rho_emp[kept, kept, drop = FALSE]); diag(r) <- 0
   i_max <- arrayInd(which.max(r), dim(r))
   if (r[i_max[1], i_max[2]] <= low_dedup_rho_max) break
   m1 <- kept[i_max[1]]; m2 <- kept[i_max[2]]
   others <- setdiff(kept, c(m1, m2))
   if (!length(others)) {
      drop <- if (m1 == "logNSE") m2 else m1
   } else {
      mean1 <- mean(rho_emp[m1, others]); mean2 <- mean(rho_emp[m2, others])
      # drop the more redundant member; on ties keep logNSE (reference skill)
      drop <- if (mean1 > mean2) m1 else if (mean2 > mean1) m2 else
                 if (m1 == "logNSE") m2 else m1
   }
   kept <- setdiff(kept, drop)
   drop_log[[length(drop_log) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
      module = "LOWFLOW_10",
      metric_pair = paste(m1, m2, sep = "~"),
      abs_rho = round(rho_emp[m1, m2], 3),
      dropped = drop, kept = paste(kept, collapse = "+"),
      reason = "pairwise_rho_above_0.9",
      decided_on = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"))
}
dedup_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(drop_log, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(dedup_dt,
                   file.path(low_output_dir, "metric_dedup_decision.csv"))
cat("kept metrics:", paste(kept, collapse = ", "), "\n")
if (nrow(dedup_dt)) print(dedup_dt)
```

## 4. Low-flow-aware composite ranking

```{r ranking}
# per-catchment ranks on kept metrics (lower = better), then mean of ranks
lowflow_ok <- wide[!is.na(get(kept[1])), ]
lowflow_ok[, n_kept_ok := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = kept]
lowflow_ok <- lowflow_ok[n_kept_ok == length(kept)]   # rank on complete rows

for (m in kept) {
   dirv <- if (low_metric_better_high[[m]]) -1 else 1
   lowflow_ok[, paste0("rk_", m) :=
                 data.table::frank(dirv * get(m), ties.method = "average",
                                   na.last = "keep"),
              by = catchment]
}
rk_cols <- paste0("rk_", kept)
lowflow_ok[, lowflow_rank_mean := rowMeans(.SD), .SDcols = rk_cols]

# model-level composite: sum of per-catchment mean ranks (HYD_30 construction)
lf_table <- lowflow_ok[, .(
   n_catchments = data.table::uniqueN(catchment),
   mean_lowflow_rank = round(mean(lowflow_rank_mean), 3),
   median_logNSE = round(stats::median(logNSE, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
   median_q95_bias = round(stats::median(q95_bias, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
   median_lf_volume_bias = round(stats::median(lf_volume_bias, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
   median_dry_spell_bias = round(stats::median(dry_spell_bias, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
   median_mam7_bias = round(stats::median(mam7_bias, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
), by = model]
lf_table[, composite_rank_sum := round(sum(mean_lowflow_rank), 1), by = model]
lf_table <- lf_table[, .SD[1], by = model]
lf_table <- lf_table[order(mean_lowflow_rank)]
lf_table[, lowflow_rank := seq_len(.N)]
data.table::fwrite(lf_table,
                   file.path(low_output_dir, "model_ranking_lowflow.csv"))
print(lf_table[, .(lowflow_rank, model, mean_lowflow_rank,
                   median_logNSE, median_q95_bias, n_catchments)])
```

## 5. H1 verdict: forcing rank vs low-flow rank

```{r h1}
qed_rank <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qed_dir,
                                        "model_ranking_overall.csv"))
qed_rank[, forcing_rank := seq_len(.N)]

cmp <- merge(qed_rank[, .(model, forcing_rank)],
             lf_table[, .(model, lowflow_rank)], by = "model")
stopifnot(nrow(cmp) >= 10)
rho_h1 <- suppressWarnings(
   stats::cor(cmp$forcing_rank, cmp$lowflow_rank, method = "spearman"))

# catchment-bootstrap CI: resample catchments, rebuild the composite from
# per-catchment mean ranks, re-correlate (fixed, recorded seed)
set.seed(low_boot_seed)
catchments <- sort(unique(lowflow_ok$catchment))
boot <- vapply(seq_len(low_n_boot), function(b) {
   pick <- sample(catchments, size = length(catchments), replace = TRUE)
   sub  <- lowflow_ok[catchment %in% pick,
                      .(model, r = mean(lowflow_rank_mean)), by = model]
   agg  <- sub[, .(rr = mean(r)), by = model]
   mrg  <- merge(qed_rank[, .(model, forcing_rank)],
                 agg[, .(model, lowflow_rank = data.table::frank(rr))],
                 by = "model")
   if (nrow(mrg) < 10) return(NA_real_)
   suppressWarnings(stats::cor(mrg$forcing_rank, mrg$lowflow_rank,
                               method = "spearman"))
}, numeric(1))
ci <- stats::quantile(boot, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

fails_h1 <- !is.na(rho_h1) && rho_h1 > low_h1_rho_fail
verdict  <- if (is.na(rho_h1)) "INDETERMINATE" else if (fails_h1) "FAILS" else "SUPPORTED"

h1_lines <- c(
   "# H1 verdict -- forcing rank vs low-flow rank",
   "",
   paste0("**Date:** ", format(Sys.time()),
          " | **metric_version:** ",
          data.table::fread(file.path(low_output_dir, "lowflow_metrics.csv"),
                            select = "metric_version")[1]),
   paste0("**Rule (pre-registered 18 Nov 2026, AGENTS.md):** H1 fails if the ",
          "pooled Spearman rho > ", low_h1_rho_fail,
          "; negative results are results."),
   "",
   paste0("**Pooled rho (forcing composite rank vs low-flow composite rank):** ",
          sprintf("%.3f", rho_h1)),
   paste0("**Bootstrap 95% CI (", low_n_boot,
          " catchment resamples, seed ", low_boot_seed, "):** ",
          sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci[1], ci[2])),
   paste0("**Verdict: ", verdict, "**"),
   "",
   "Interpretation: a rho near zero means low-flow skill is nearly",
   "uncorrelated with whole-flow/forcing skill -- the two-stage framework",
   "carries information a forcing-only selection would miss. A rho > ",
   low_h1_rho_fail, " would collapse the framework to one stage and the",
   "paper must report that honestly.",
   "",
   paste0("Models ranked: ", nrow(cmp), " | catchments: ", length(catchments),
          " | metrics kept after de-dup: ", paste(kept, collapse = ", ")))
writeLines(h1_lines, file.path(low_output_dir, "h1_verdict.md"))
cat("H1 pooled rho =", round(rho_h1, 3), "| CI [",
    round(ci[1], 3), ",", round(ci[2], 3), "] |", verdict, "\n")

data.table::fwrite(cmp, file.path(low_output_dir, "h1_rank_pairs.csv"))
```

## Take-away

- `model_ranking_lowflow.csv` -- the low-flow-aware ranking (O1 deliverable).
- `h1_verdict.md` -- the H1 verdict file; **the paper's results section is
  written against this file, not against memory** (AGENTS.md convention).
- `metric_dedup_decision.csv` -- the auditable de-duplication record.
- If H1 fails (rho > 0.6): report, do not tune; the framework collapses to a
  single-stage selection and P1 reframes accordingly.
